this function is part of an equivalence, provided by `EquivFunctor.mapEquiv`.

doc:
The "Discrete" category on a type, whose morphisms are equalities.

Because we do not allow morphisms in `Prop` (only in `Type`),
somewhat annoyingly we have to define `X ⟶ Y` as `ULift (PLift (X = Y))`.

  CategoryTheory.SmallCategory (CategoryTheory.Discrete α)

value.text:
fun α =>
  { Hom := fun X Y => ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift (X.as = Y.as)), id := fun x => { down := { down := ⋯ } },
    comp := fun {X Y Z} g f =>
      CategoryTheory.Discrete.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
        X = t → ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift (X.as = Z.as))) X
        (fun as h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {X} =>
            ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift (X.as = Y.as)) → ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift (X.as = Z.as)))
            (fun g =>
              CategoryTheory.Discrete.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                Y = t → ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = Z.as))) Y
                (fun as_1 h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {Y} =>
                    ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift (Y.as = Z.as)) →
                      ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = Y.as)) →
                        ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = Z.as)))
                    (fun f g =>
                      CategoryTheory.Discrete.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                        Z = t → ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = Z.as))) Z
                        (fun as_2 h =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {Z} =>
                            ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as_1 }.as = Z.as)) →
                              ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = Z.as)))
                            (fun f =>
                              ULift.casesOn f fun down =>
                                PLift.casesOn down fun down =>
                                  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
                                    { as := as_2 }.as = a →
                                      down ≍ x →
                                        ULift.{u₁, 0} (PLift ({ as := as }.as = { as := as_2 }.as)))
                                    down
                                    (fun h =>
                                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as_3 =>
                                        (down : { as := as_1 }.as = { as := as_3 }.as) →
                                          down ≍ ⋯ →
                                            ULift.{u₁, 0}
                                              (PLift ({ as := as }.as = { as := as_3 }.as)))
                                        (fun down h => g) ⋯ down)
                                    ⋯ ⋯)
                            ⋯ f)
                        ⋯)
                    ⋯ f g)
                ⋯)
            ⋯ g)
        ⋯,
    id_comp := ⋯, comp_id := ⋯, assoc := ⋯ }
